name: Squeak
subtitle: Your coding agents, in your pocket

apps.name: Squeak
apps.subtitle: Answer your agents from anywhere
apps.localizedDescription: See every coding agent running on your Mac, read what it said, and answer its questions. Pairs with Squeak for Mac; replies are end-to-end encrypted and signed by this phone's Secure Enclave.
apps.versionDescription: Opens instantly from cache: ponds, your Macs and recent chats; chats load ahead as you scroll; archive and rename apply at once.

versions.localizedDescription: Opens instantly from cache: ponds, your Macs and recent chats; chats load ahead as you scroll; archive and rename apply at once.
Sign in and see your Macs — no codes. Switch between Macs. Chats load instantly from an encrypted on-device history. A pond lists every thread. Calmer syncing.
Recent no longer empties on a failed read; Face ID no longer drops the live stream; the connection bar no longer resizes lists; ponds drawn exactly as your Mac sends them.
Ponds are one per project, exactly as on your Mac: no duplicates or folder names; chats outside any project sit in Other
Ponds now match your Mac: every chat sits in its pond, chats outside any project fold into one Other group, and ponds show the same letter marks as on the Mac

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Squeak uses the camera once, to scan the pairing code on your Mac.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Squeak asks for Face ID before it sends anything to your agents.
